summary: Rewrites the VCarve, Engrave and Deburr selection gates in Path/Op/Gui/Selection.py so the expensive Volume check only runs for whole-object selections; as a side effect VCarve now accepts Edge sub-elements and Engrave now accepts Face sub-elements in the Base Geometry picker, while Deburr's accepted selection is unchanged. The source-map candidates (index, set-start-point, drilling, pocket, profile) are wrong for these hunks and were dropped.

pages.reason: Selection.py VCARVEGate.allow: the explicit 'Edge sub-element -> False' branch is removed and replaced by `sub[0:4] in ("Edge", "Face")`, so edges of a solid can now be added as base geometry alongside faces
Selection.py ENGRAVEGate.allow: previously only Edge sub-elements (or whole zero-volume wire objects) passed; now `sub[0:4] in ("Edge", "Face")` lets Face sub-elements be selected as base geometry

Selection.py CHAMFERGate.allow: Edge and Face sub-elements and whole zero-volume edge objects were already accepted; the rewrite only drops the Volume call for sub-element preselection, so the documented selectable geometry is unchanged
